purpose: Generic review criteria for documents: lists the delegated SSOT documents to check, the check order, and the rules for choosing fix, create_issue or skip recommendations, without holding its own judgments.
summary: Delegation table of SSOT documents by priority P1 to P3 (document style guide, project-specific rules, error classification spec, consistency check, spec priorities)
Fallback to built-in rules when project-specific rules are not available
Check order: style conformance, project rules, error handling, contradictions, unnecessary complexity
Error handling check against the error classification spec (swallowed errors, detectable events, per-cause values)
P2 contradiction detection limited to conflicting statements, not omissions
P3 unnecessary complexity judged Yes/No against spec priorities perverse patterns
Judgment rules for recommendation values fix, create_issue and skip with adoption conditions
Three conditions for create_issue: no applicable rule, recurrence or objectivity, rule-writable granularity
tasks: Building a review packet for document review
Deciding recommendation values fix, create_issue or skip for review findings
Revising review criteria or delegation targets
Reviewing documents that define error handling
title: generic レビュー基準
